svg.title: Exact finite batch retraining: atoms, mean, and variance
svg.desc: Four panels show exact probability masses at selected rounds. Two lower panels show the ensemble mean and parameter variance of the same m=1 process. The horizontal dashed lines are the population fixed point one half and limiting variance one twelfth. These are not sample paths or confidence intervals.
svg.text: Same exact law: the mean settles, the parameter distribution does not
m=1; theta0=0; new independent fair Bernoulli every round
Parameter variance, not a mean confidence interval
Top: discrete probability mass. Bottom: exact moments. Dashed lines: population fixed point / limiting variance.
